name: Formal Guilds
description: Federations and associations of merchants have loosely existed throughout our nation's history. However, we could choose to placate the most powerful traders across our markets by formalizing their participation in a centralized and officially recognized corpus. Such a privilege will undoubtedly impact both our foreign and domestic policies.

name: Trade Monopolies
description: Giving the most powerful merchants in our countries exclusive trading rights to our mercantile goods to powerful merchants will greatly increase the influence of our most prominent traders. This policy will influence our national attitude towards foreign merchants.

name: Control over Monetary Policy
description: The finances of our nation are a topic of great importance as we strive to improve and perfect our ledgers. Perhaps it would be a good idea to entrust the wealthy members of our society with such a task, and in return provide them with reduced taxation on their commodities and assets.

name: Building Rights
description: Developing our settlements and cities is a costly endeavor. By granting building rights to the local population, we will ultimately reduce the overall end cost of development. However, giving the people such an allowance will considerably increase their influence.

name: Royal Burgh Commissioners
description: The Royal Burgh Commissioners, representing the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')]-chartered burghs of [GetCountry('SCO').GetName], convene regularly to safeguard their privileges, regulate commerce, and advise the nation's ruler. Through their collective authority in the Convention of Royal Burghs, they ensure that [GetCountry('SCO').GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s trading communities remain vital to governance, economy, and law, standing as a counterweight to the power of the $nobles_estate$ and [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')].

name: $burghers_estate$ Land Rights
description: The laws regarding land ownership have recently been the matter of much heated debate at court. We shall expand the land ownership rights of our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')], with the goal of making the various administrative guilds more compliant in exchange for having been given more power.

name: Commercial Advisory Council
description: Trade is the lifeblood of our economy. Thus, we must ensure that our head of state is supported by only the most capable and knowledgeable individuals, adept in matters of maritime and land trade. This will benefit our commercial capabilities at home and abroad.

name: Milanese Cloth Guilds
description: Our valuable cloth industry rests upon the shoulders of the finest craftsmen in all of [ShowRegionName('italy_region')]. By entrusting their regulations and production lines to our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')], we will attain record profits and productivity at the minor cost of granting our merchant guilds some influence.

name: [GetCountry('FLO').GetNameWithNoTooltip] Guilds
description:
The different artisans and merchants of [GetCountry('FLO').GetName] traditionally are associates in different guilds. This ensures not only a high standard of quality for the products, but also avoids breeding unfair competition. However, the power and influence these guilds hold as a result is undeniable.

This unlocks the [law|e] [ShowLawName('guilds_of_florence')].

name: Arte della Lana
description: The #italic Arte della Lana#! — the Wool Guild — is one of the most powerful of the seven major guilds of [GetCountry('FLO').GetName], controlling every stage of the wool trade from the purchase of raw fleece to the sale of finished cloth. Its membership encompasses merchants, dyers, weavers, and finishers, all bound by strict quality standards enforced by guild inspectors. Granting formal recognition to the Arte entrenches the influence of the merchant class and ensures that [GetCountry('FLO').GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s reputation for fine cloth remains unmatched across the continent.

name: Ivan's Hundred
description: The heads of the Ivan's Hundred, our local merchant guild, are permanent members of the commerce court of [ShowLocationName('novgorod')] and the ruling council of the Novgorod Republic. With their political presence and the agreements they have made with the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], our nation will surely enjoy continued, successful trade.

name: Control of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('lake_chad')]
description: Across the shores of [ShowLocationName('lake_chad')], our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] interact and exchange goods with a multitude of folk from faraway lands. This volume of commerce, fully under our control, is the lifeblood of our economy and the foundation of our national stability.

name: Serfdom Economy
description: Our empire was built on the backs of our conquered enemies. The flow of forced labor within our nation is a cornerstone of our economy, with frequent raids and conquests further fueling our wealth and power.

name: Amenokal Salt Traders
description: Seasoned veterans of Saharan trade, these individuals oversee and drive the caravans of [ShowGoodsName('salt')] that traverse the inhospitable deserts.

name: Protected Faith of the Wealthy
description: The wealthy members of our society have gained Religious Protections and are therefore exempt from any conversion attempts from the state.

name: Land of Commerce
description: We pride ourselves on being a nation that takes great care of its [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')], assuring they have access to legal representation, can move around swiftly as needed, and have the freedom to transport their goods as they see fit.

name: Treasury Rights
description: By granting the oversight of our treasury to wealthy, powerful members of our society, we will secure their interests and increase their loyalty to us, albeit at the expense of losing some tax revenue.

name: Urban Development Grants
description: It has become clear to us that the future will dawn within city walls. To promote and usher in this new era of urbanization, city-dwellers will be given several grants to promote urbanization across our realm.

name: Sponsored Maritime Contracts
description: Maritime trade is a valuable source of revenue for our treasury. By granting exclusive contracts to our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')], we can regulate commerce while ensuring consistent tax income from shipping and trade.

name: Control over the Coinage
description: Cutting and circulating new coins of adequate quality is a complicated, yet essential process for the development of a sovereign people. By taking control of the coinage, we will strengthen our economic foundations and consolidate our authority.

name: Allow Trade Center Sponsorship
description: By sponsoring various trade centers across our realm, we will make sure that [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] and people of coin have ample facilities in which to exchange wares and establish a healthy flow of trade.

name: Shipwright Contracts
description: Granting favorable state-sponsored contracts to wealthy members of our society will allow us to adopt a more efficient grasp on our shipwright processes and cut down on the regulatory red tape around the industry.

name: Market Fairs
description: The financing and development of merchant centers will surely attract higher trade traffic, while simultaneously amassing great wealth, ample quantities of various exotic goods, and a reputation for security.

name: Fund the Karimi Merchants
description: Funding the powerful [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] known as the Karimi, who are responsible for the trade of spices as well as other valuable goods, is essential to our continued prosperity.

name: Toll & Tariff Exemptions
description: The exemption of merchant vessels from paying dues to transport their goods will certainly go a long way towards ensuring that the [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] approve of our administration.

name: Dedicated Merchant Courts
description: These courts are dedicated to resolving disputes between our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')]. They are a powerful branch of our government, and exert enormous influence over commercial and mercantile matters.

name: Elite Patronage
description: Our mercantile presence must not atrophy. To ensure a robust and continuous stream of trade, it falls upon the shoulders of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] to be the patrons of our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] and ensure they have ample coin with which to ferry their goods.

name: [GetCountry('POL').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Merchant Seal
description: A seal bearing the insignia of our central authority, this document permits free, uninterrupted travel for our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')], allowing them more expedient passage between cities for themselves and their goods in exchange for a small supplemental tax.

name: Privateer Contracts
description: In order to expand our naval capabilities without having to maintain a large standing fleet, we shall regulate and officially oversee acts of piracy that benefit the nation. Our privateers operate under official sanction, sharing their plunder with the crown in exchange for legal protection. However, the fine line between privateering and piracy requires us to be cautious if we do not wish to damage our international reputation…

name: Ceremonial Tax Exemptions
description: The preparation of tributes, sacrifices, and festivals is a great honor for our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')]. In exchange for this responsibility, they shall be exempt from regular taxation.

name: Kulm Law
description: A modified version of the Magdeburg Law, the Kulm Law grants all cities in [ShowAreaName('prussia_area')] that have secured the mercantile interests of the city merchant guilds the privilege of significant autonomy from their overlords.

name: Villes Franches
description: Several of our market towns have experienced considerable growth in recent decades. As a result, they have become symbols of the expansion of the Crown's power throughout the kingdom, in opposition to the feudal lords who dominate the countryside.

name: Leadership of Étienne Marcel
description: Étienne Marcel's influence has made the [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] a powerful force in the Estates-General.

name: The Great Ordinance
description: Following immense pressure from Étienne Marcel, [GetCountry('FRA').GetName] is currently governed by terms of Marcel's Great Ordinance. In return for granting him great influence, the state has the backing of the Estates-General to levy more taxes.

name: Compromise Great Ordinance
description: A compromise agreement between the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] and Étienne Marcel, where the $crown_estate$ cedes power to Marcel. In return, the Estates-General has granted the request to levy more taxes.

name: Petty Bureaucracy
description: The main bureaucratic corps of our country is made up of highly educated specialists and administrators who manage the daily tasks and support the structure of the government.

name: Cardinal-Lead Guilds
description: Guilds and other associations of merchants and tradesmen are a necessary evil. By putting a pious cardinal in charge of them, we will ensure that no organization will stray from the path of God, and that the sin of greed will not cloud the minds of our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')].

name: Libro d'Argento
description: Together with the #italic Libro d'Oro#! that list all the noble families of the [GetCountry('VEN').GetLongName], the #italic Libro d'Argento#! contains the names of all the #italic Originarii#! families, who despite being commoners descend from the original inhabitants of the lagoon, and have gained thus the right to trade as citizens of [GetCountry('VEN').GetNameWithNoTooltip] and take jobs in the administration of the [GetCountry('VEN').GetGovernment.GetGovernmentType.GetName].

name: Kreditwerk
description: The #italic Kreditwerk#! controls large parts of our finances, hindering our financial capabilities.

name: Reformed Kreditwerk
description: The #italic Kreditwerk#!, now reformed under the direct control of the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')], will enable us to more efficiently finance our projects.

name: [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('tamil')] Trading Rights
description: The [ShowAreaName('tamil_land_area')] is home to many great mercantile cities of the [ShowCultureName('tamil')] people. By granting them trade and autonomy privileges, we can ensure their loyalty and value to the state.

name: [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')] Banking Rights
description: [ShowReligionName('jain')] is no longer a dominant or politically favored faith in $india$, but the [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')] people are far from irrelevant. They have found a niche in moneylending and bureaucracy that makes them an asset to any state willing to offer them patronage.

name: [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')] Scholars
description: While [ShowReligionName('jain')] itself has lost its prominence, it is still a religion with an active minority to consider. Practitioners of this faith are educated and wise scholars who may be a boon our government if we promote them into the administration.

name: Consolidated Corruption of the Wealthy
description: The entrenched middle and upper classes $corruption_desc$

name: [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('magdeburg')] Rights
description: A set of privileges that were originally drafted using $FLA_ADJ$ law, this legal framework was spread through central [ShowContinentName('europe')] via an influx of [ShowCultureGroupName('german_group')] immigrants. Aimed at cultivating the liberties of the individual citizen, these rights serve to guarantee and regulate the autonomy of the local administration.

name: Novi Fori
description: Derived from the original set of privileges given to the city of [ShowLocationName('magdeburg')], this legal framework has grown to encompass Western concepts of urban planning, as well as a set of criminal and civil laws, when it spread beyond the core [ShowCultureGroupName('german_group')] lands.

name: Shooting Societies
description: Organized militia of [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] and craftsmen aimed at practicing drills and defending their city against all outside invaders. These associations are permitted by the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] to don special uniforms and display emblems that are otherwise only permitted to the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')].

name: Building Roads Rights
description: Allow rich [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] to develop our infrastructure by building [roads|e], benefiting both our ever-expanding economy and the traders themselves.

name: [ShowLanguageNameWithNoTooltip('kannada_language')] Literature Aid
description: By allowing the wealthy members of our society rights over the matters of the [ShowLanguageName('kannada_language')] language, we can ensure that our literary oeuvre does not fall into obscurity.

name: Allow Religious Practices
description: Instead of focusing only on the [ShowReligionNameWithNoTooltip('hindu')] aspect of our nation, we should allow our other religious minorities the right to publically practice their faith.

name: Muḥtasib Inspectors
description: The #italic Muḥtasib#! oversee marketplace integrity by inspecting [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')], publicly punishing financial criminals, and developing manuals to identify and prevent fraud.

name: Trunk Road to $erzurum$
description: $anatolia_region$ is connected to $tabriz$ and $persia_region$ through a reliable network of trunk roads. As we directly control one of its critical junctions, our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] reap great benefits.

name: Mit'a System
description: The $cas_mita_system$ is an adaptation of an Incan labor draft that forces indigenous communities to provide rotating labor for our enterprises, especially in silver mines like those of Potosí.

name: Royal Factories
description: Royal Factories are state-sponsored, but privately owned enterprises granted royal privilege and oversight. They operate under official sanction to bolster domestic industry while retaining commercial autonomy.

name: [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('iranian_group')] Art Patronage
description: Patronage of the arts by our [ShowCultureGroupName('iranian_group')] elites has made it possible for extraordinary new styles of art to develop and flourish.

name: Guild Investments
description: The guilds have agreed to divert a portion of their funds toward making improvements to our production process. Though many of these ventures will likely fail, a few may yield breakthroughs that can reshape our capital economy.

name: Religious Literacy Rights
description: Our religion has many associated works of literature containing the practices, morals, and principles of our faith. Our [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] should have unlimited access to the written word in order to study the holy texts of our faith.

name: Strengthened Faith
description: Faith is what keeps our people united, even during the most challenging times. Thanks to the efforts of our [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')], our people have emerged from their most recent trial unshaken in their beliefs and more faithful than before!

name: Enforced Religious Unity
description: Our country is home to people of many different beliefs, and coexistence is becoming increasingly difficult, which in turn weakens our government. We must enforce the rule that our subjects may only practice our State Religion in order to quell this disunity — and to consolidate our authority.

name: Military Orders
description: The Military Orders were created after the Crusades began, as a means of fusing the discipline and devotion of monks with the martial skill and experience of knights. They spread throughout Christendom, but other religions also developed similar orders when fighting wars of religion.

name: Lecture Oaths
description: Our ancient universities are famous for producing the most influential minds in the land, and so they must be protected and controlled. Graduates are sworn never to lecture outside the walls of these centers of learning.

name: Religious Land Rights
description: We have decided to give the faithful the right to own private land. This will make them more powerful and influential, but will also allow for a more constant presence of holy men at our disposal.

name: Religious Advisory Council
description: We have decided to form a council of advisors, comprised entirely of holy [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')]. This will make them more influential, but also more complacent, as they will be able to express their concerns directly to us and see their interests satisfied.

name: Powerful Dioceses
description: The administration of our territory lies in the hands of the state. However, the organization of the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] does not follow our provincial systems. Instead, the they organize themselves in Dioceses, which have significant power and influence over the internal affairs of our country.

name: Protected Faith of the Religious
description: Holy men and women have gained Religious Protections and are therefore exempt from any conversion attempts from the state.

name: Religious Administration
description: By making matters of religion our foremost priority, we shall forge our nation into a more cohesive whole.

name: Expansionist Zealotry
description: To wage war for our faith is the divine calling of all true believers!

name: Religious Diplomats
description: Good diplomacy is difficult to maintain; it only takes a few simple misunderstandings for the relationship between two countries to sour completely. By sending particularly pious diplomats to our brethren in faith, we shall rely on the strength of that commonality to build fruitful, lasting political relationships.

name: Promote Cultural Unity
description: The basis of a strong and coherent society is essentially the promotion of one culture to unite all our people and protect them from foreign influences.

name: Embellish Great Works of Faith
description: There is no better way to display our magnanimity and strength of faith than to erect major works or architectural splendor, dedicated to the purity of divinity.

name: Papal Emissary
description: The legates and other emissaries of the [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] are most welcome in our territory. Moreover, we shall also commit to obeying their judgment, and to never interfere in relations between our local [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] and the [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle].

name: Freedom of Interpretation
description: The many teachings of our faith are like the cool shade underneath a great tree, where all may rest and be refreshed. Under this protective canopy of wisdom, our people are encouraged to think deeply about matters of faith, and to expand and diversify our tenets. This freedom of interpretation will allow our religion to adapt to diverse communities while yet maintaining its core principles.

name: Waqf Payments
description: To demonstrate our piety and religious dedication, we will grant #italic waqf#! payments as charitable endowments, which shall be used to fund madrasas, hospitals, and mosques, as well as to aid the less fortunate.

name: Maintain Clerical Proceedings
description: Despite our commitment to republican ideals, we permit the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] to retain their traditional privileges and jurisdiction over matters of faith, morality, and church law.

name: State Official Oaths
description: All government officials in our domain must swear allegiance to the one true faith under the blessing of the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] before they may take office.

name: Mandatory Clerical Donations
description: Our subjects are required to pay tithes to our religious institutions. These mandatory contributions are a divine responsibility, demonstrating the piety and strength of faith our people hold.

name: Sponsor Printing of Religious Texts
description: Circulating printed religious texts is an excellent way to spread literacy and entrench the teachings of our faith firmly within our people's hearts. These efforts to distribute religious literature will educate our people and remind them of their religious responsibilities.

name: Liturgical Mural Art
description: Our palatial walls will be adorned with captivating religious scenes created by the nation's most gifted artists, as a way to showcase the beauty of our faith and profess our love towards the divine.

name: Apostolic Tax
description: Our servitude to the highest authority of the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] faith can never be mere promises. By committing to support the [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle], we are sure to win his favor.

name: Tax Exemption
description: Our faith is served by devout men and woman who dedicate their lives to the care and the spiritual well-being of our people. It is only natural that they are not forced to pay any tithe to the government.

name: $clergy_estate$ in Administration
description: The servants of the faith already possess many skills we look for in administrators. They are well-educated, experienced scribes who follow a higher calling. In many ways, allying ourselves with them would create an efficient and very strong cadre of administrators.

name: Consolidated Corruption of the Faith
description: The unfortunate reality that our religious leaders have a say over our internal politics is only a side effect of the other corrupt deals they have extorted from us under the threat of excommunication.

name: Commons Petition
description: A list of grievances put forward following the Pilgrimage of Grace uprising.

name: Austere Monastic Life
description:
Life in our religious orders has finally returned to its cloistered, austere ideal. The accumulation of wealth is restricted, and monastic focus is entirely set on contemplation and prayer.

Additional monasteries may be created.

name: Unity of Brethren
description: A movement of radical [ShowReligionName('hussite')] focused around the bare elegance of preaching and worshipping, focusing on excluding powerful individuals from the [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] and [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] while promoting the mother tongue and simplified ceremonies during communion.

name: Warrior Tribunal
description: A jurisprudent framework across our lands that is imbued with legal authority to pass judgment on a variety of crimes.

name: Hurin Qusqu High Priesthood
description: The Hurin Qusqu retain the duty and privilege of serving Inti directly as the #italic Villaq Umu#!, the High Priest of Inti.

name: Reduced Military Obligations
description: In exchange for their loyalty to our central authority, we can reduce or do away with military obligations for those who embrace a life of faith in the arms of the divine.

name: Pragmatic Sanction of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('bourges')]
description: Through these sanctions, the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] Church in [GetCountry('FRA').GetName] obtains greater administrative independence from [GetCountry('PAP').GetName], as it allows electoral appointment to ecclesiastical offices through the means of a general Church council. While these sanctions please the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')], our influence and relationship with the Holy See may suffer.

name: [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('french_group')] Cardinals
description: Since the death of [GetCharacter('pap_boniface_viii').GetName] and the court's relocation to [ShowLocationName('avignon')], most of the cardinals flocking to it are [ShowCultureGroupName('french_group')] and under the influence of the [GetCountry('FRA').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] of [GetCountry('FRA').GetName], whose grip on the [GetCountry('PAP').GetName] will not allow a return to [ShowLocationName('rome')].

name: Dharmic Ḏimmī Communities
description: Originally a term reserved for [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] and [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('israelite_group')] communities, the #italic Ḏimmī#! refers to the [ShowReligionAdjective('hindu')] and other [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('dharmic')] believers living in the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] world. Traditionally, it is the responsibility of the ruler to protect them. However, this is not always as easy, as the #italic Ḏimmī#! constitute the majority of the population. But, with the support of the true faith, the #italic Ḏimmī#! shall swear loyalty to the state without threatening the tenets of [ShowReligionGroupNameWithNoTooltip('muslim')].

name: Monastery Reform of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('melk')]
description: Following the advice of our best clerical advisors, we have reformed our monasteries in accordance with [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] principles.

name: Concordat of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('vienna')]
description: Our agreement with the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetLeaderTitle] will stabilize our relations. However, we will have to cede some power to the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] in order to appease the [GetCountry('PAP').GetAdjective] forces.

name: Patronization Rights of Minor Deities
description: The [ShowReligionName('hindu')] deities are numerous, and it is better for our people if we grant them rights to worship whichever gods they prefer.

name: Promotion of [ShowReligiousGroupAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('muslim')] Scholars
description: To further elevate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as the center of [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] learning, we must ensure more scholars enter our administration, despite the allegiances they might have.

name: Autonomous Kadiluks
description: #italic Qāḍī#! should be given greater power within their alloted #italic Kadiluk#! jurisdictions, to better utilize their wisdom for the benefit of the state.

name: Clerical Aristocracy
description: A union between the wealthy landowners and the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')], wherein legal ownership of the land is transferred to the $clergy_estate$ to ensure said property can never be confiscated by the nation.

name: Protector of the Patriarchate of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')]
description: The return of the Crusaders to [ShowLocationName('constantinople')] has seen the Patriarchate restored once again. With a strengthened [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] presence in [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')], the Patriarchate will serve to become the symbol of [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('catholic')] rule in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')] once more.

name: Cossack Land Rights
description: The Cossacks live in their own communities with their own organization. By guaranteeing the autonomy of their territories, we will ensure that they remain loyal to us.

name: Sanctioned Atamans
description: An #italic ataman#! is the leader of a Cossack group. By officially sanctioning their leadership, we will tie them to our rule, albeit at the cost of giving them more authority.

name: Allowed Free Roaming
description: Cossacks are traditionally semi-nomadic, not permanently settling in any fixed place for long. Allowing them to retain mobility will go far in preserving their way of life... and in keeping them willing to work for us.

name: Cossack Government Positions
description: The harsh life that the Cossacks lead breeds resilient individuals. Instead of permitting them to freely roam our lands, we could recruit the most talented and hardy among them to the administration.

name: Cossack Military Service
description: The Cossacks live in a highly militarized society. Instead of allowing them to freely roam the countryside, we shall incorporate them into our military system so that we may take advantage of their battle prowess.

name: Protected Faith of the Cossacks
description: The Cossacks are traditionally diverse in their religious beliefs, albeit mostly sharing the same faith. By respecting their personal beliefs, we can avoid breeding religious tensions — not only among themselves, but also between them and us.

name: Respected Cossack Traditions
description: The Cossacks have their own traditions and social organization. We need to respect these foundational aspects of their culture if we wish them to truly feel like equal members of our society.

name: Rada Autonomy
description: The administration of the Cossacks centers around the #italic Rada#!, meaning assembly or council, where they decide upon all matters both military and civil. By giving these Rada legal autonomy from our own administration, we can delegate the governance of their territories to themselves, at the same time as we ensure their complacency.

name: Registered Cossacks
description: Not only shall the Cossacks serve in our military, but shall also be organized with a specific register and their own specific officer ranks, so that they can most efficiently fight in our wars.

name: Exploration by the Cossacks
description: The Cossacks are used to a roaming life, which has taught them to traverse and thrive in almost every type of terrain. We can use these abilities to send them out on expeditions into the unknown, where they will discover new lands for us to take.

name: Colonization by the Cossacks
description: The freeroaming lifestyle of the Cossacks makes them ideal candidates to send into unclaimed regions and make preparations for establishing permanent settlements.

name: Treaty of Hadiach
description: The $plc_cossack_treaty_of_hadiach$ concedes many powers and rights to the Cossacks, the most important concession of which being the inclusion of their nation in the Commonwealth, forming the Polish-Lithuanian-Ruthenian state.

name: Cossack Identity
description: The Cossacks have a distinct and proud identity, with their own traditions and customs. They do not easily abandon them due to outside influences, but stand firm and follow their own way of living.

name: Guarantee Local Land Rights
description: A man's home is his refuge. By guaranteeing property rights to heathen members of our society, we will establish a link of trust between them and our administration.

name: Lighter Taxation
description: The secret to a stable multifaith society is simply fair treatment and warm kindness — and, more concretely, tax breaks. By imposing fewer taxes on heathen subjects under our banner, we will ensure their compliance going forward.

name: Allow Military Service
description: The many heathen believers who peacefully occupy our lands are more than willing to defend their livelihoods and their families, should we permit their recruitment.

name: Promote Tolerance
description: Our people frequently cite a desire to build a more diverse and tolerant society. Acting on their behest and following their example, we will treat non-believers with kindness as we strive to achieve stability and prosperity.

name: Grant Administrative Posts
description: Our borders are home to many who do not follow our state religion. Their local leaders are keen on maintaining their positions and beliefs. To cooperate with them and share in their wisdom is the natural path to a healthy administration.

name: Preserve Local Traditions
description: Our subjects come from many corners of the earth, and as such, have different believe and lifeways. From lowly fieldhands to displaced members of their former noble classes, they can all boast of the storied histories and beautiful traditions of their people. To respect and allow the practice of diverse customs is the mark of a superior, harmonious society.

name: Legal Autonomy
description: There are many good citizens in our territory who do not follow our state religion, yet they have been integrated into our legal system and enjoy the same rights as others. Despite protests against their inclusion, allowing them to participate in our judicial framework as witnesses, guardians, and legal representatives of their communities will only further their support of our authority.

name: Promote Local Hierarchy
description: As we strive to maintain social equilibrium, our advisors have deemed it necessary to coordinate with representatives from the many local communities who do not adhere to our state faith.

name: Pact of Umar
description: This treaty clearly defines the status, rights, and responsibilities of 'protected persons' within our realm, including Christians, Jews, Zoroastrians, and many other recognized faiths.

name: Maẓālim Courts
description: Parallel to the authority and existence of religio-judicial administration and Sharī'a courts, the Maẓālim operate secularly for the affairs of the unbelievers. Their sessions can take place at the Palace of Justice (#italic dār al-'adl#!) or ceremonial hall within the citadel walls (#italic īwan kabīr#!).

name: Abrahamic Communities
description: The [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] and [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('israelite_group')] communities are the so-called #italic Ḏimmī#! in a [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] state. Traditionally, it is the responsibility of a just ruler to protect these people while keeping them apart from the [ShowReligionGroupAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('muslim')] majority, and the #italic Ḏimmī#! community shall swear loyalty to the state without threatening the traditions of [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')].

name: Ḏimmī Bureaucrats
description: Some of our country's finest administrators follow different faiths than our own, yet are nontheless upstanding and loyal members of our nation. Excluding those who are willing to serve us and the state would be a grave mistake, and we should rectify this immediately.

name: Ḥabshī Advisors
description: Known for their prolific and influential presence in matters of state, these slaves come from the shores of [ShowSubContinentName('east_africa')]. Educated in matters of administration and warfare, they provide a great service in exchange for political influence and, potentially, freedom after religious conversion.

name: Offensive Military Doctrine
description: Our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] lean towards aggressive military tactics, ascribing to the idea that a good offense is the best defense. Their commanders and soldiers are predisposed toward bold, decisive action, seeking the swift destruction of our enemies.

name: Land Rights
description: This represents the privileges our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] have over the lands they rule and the people who inhabit them. Among those rights, $nobles_estate$ can usually tax the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] living on their lands, draft them to form levies, or mete out justice on their own. These holdings are usually hereditary.

name: Auxilium et Consilium
description: [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] receive privileges, but they also have obligations to their Lord. They have to provide troops — #italic auxilium#! — and maintain fortifications and infrastructures in the lands they rule, but they also have to give counsel — #italic consilium#! — to their Lord when requested.

name: $nobles_estate$ Controlled Serfdom
description: Among the rights [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] have over the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] in their lands, they can tax them, levy them, and exert justice upon them as needed. Peasants living under these conditions become serfs and are usually bound to the land they worked.

name: Fortification Licenses
description: One outcome of our feudal system has been the proliferation of castles and forts built by the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] as a means of increasing their power and authority. That has had further effects on our society, as the $nobles_estate$ are able to entrench and fortify themselves within their inherited dominions.

name: Royal Marriage Rights
description: The [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] of our country are considered to be peers to our rulers. Therefore, they are eligible to marry into the ruling family, subsequently increasing their influence and power at court, as well as in the government.

name: Banal Lordship
description: This type of manorial domination developed under the feudal system and is based on the 'ban', which is the authority of a lord to command his tenants, give them orders, and punish them. This has led to the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] having greater power in their domains, since they are the ones who dole out justice within their territories and can also tax the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] for most of their economic activities.

name: Primacy of $nobles_estate$
description: The [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] of our country has proven to be key allies, as they support most of our enterprises and are the backbone of our armies. For this reason, they consider themselves our equals, and they have become so crucial to the government that we must consult with them before making important decisions.

name: Only $nobles_estate$ as Leaders
description: Our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] believe that they are the only ones capable of leading our armies and navies, due to the events of the past. However, this rankles members of the other Estates, who think that the $nobles_estate$ are arrogant fools.

name: Elaborate Court Life
description: We have decided to imbue the courtly life of our country with the most elaborate formality imaginable. As everyone who is anyone is expected to attend our ruler in the capital, this restricts how much plotting the $nobles_estate$ can do against us, but it does come at a high cost.

name: Protected Faith of the Elites
description: The elites have gained Religious Protections and are therefore exempt from any conversion attempts from the state.

name: Elite Council
description: At a time where the elites are extremely influential — and can precipitate the rise and fall dynasties — it is fundamentally wise to give them certain key positions in the administrative council.

name: Manorial Courts
description: The right to hold court, despite not actually being rulers, is quite a valuable privilege for the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. By emulating their liege and claiming the power to arbitrate disputes, levy fines and taxes, and enforce their own laws, they can amass great wealth and command higher authority across their domain — for better or for worse…

name: Increased Civic Engagement
description: Encouraging the public to engage with sociopolitical matters is an excellent way to safeguard the health of our nation. If they are more involved with the politics and administration of the country, surely they will work harder to ensure its prosperous future.

name: Inherited Offices
description: While it is true that most other realms with administrations like ours tend to hold elections for government roles, we have come to realize that if we are to secure the loyalty of the elites, we must allow them exclusive access to hereditary offices.

name: Recognized Communes
description: Many of our settlements, both urban and rural, have become increasingly autonomous under their landholding elite. While recognizing these breakaways as legitimate entities may reduce our control over their affairs, it will nevertheless please the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')].

name: Appoint Ecclesiastical Offices
description: Nobility and divinity are concepts that have become increasingly interwoven within our pious society. The crown retains the right to appoint high church officials, which ensures that the beneficiaries remain loyal to the state while gaining influence of their own.

name: Control of the Borderlands
description: Protecting the faithful who live far from our capital is an arduous task. By commanding the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] in those lands to protect their people, we will shield our people against heathens and heretical foes.

name: Feudal Mercenary Contracts
description: The armies levied by our people often leave a lot to be desired. In order to protect our people and best our rivals, we must rely on foreign mercenaries, whose contracts will be managed by the elite members of our society.

name: Liberum Veto
description: This introduces the requirement for unanimous voting in the $country_flavor_parliament_sejm$. Any noble could stop any vote or legislation by standing up and shouting #italic Sisto activitatem!#! ('I stop the activity!') in Latin, or #italic Nie pozwalam!#! ('I do not allow!') in Polish.

name: Visconti City States
description: The [GetCountry('MLO').GetLongName] under the Visconti family is marked by a fractured and decentralized state. Different prominent members of the Visconti house, including Azzone, Gian Galeazzo, and Bernabò, vie for supremacy through various tactics such as alliances, betrayals, and military campaigns. This constant power struggle constantly weakens the central authority of the [GetCountry('MLO').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip] and contribute to a state of instability and fragmentation in the region.

name: General Privilege of [GetCountry('ARA').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: The General Privilege is a list of deals and laws that compels the monarch to guarantee traditional nobiliary rights and to ask for the parliament's permission before declaring war.

name: Privilege of the Union
description: Despite resistance from the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')], the #italic 'Union of Aragon'#! has forced this set of agreements into law. It provides extensive rights to the $ARA_ADJ$ [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] and the city-dwelling people at the expense of the ruler's traditional powers.

name: Signoria Council
description: The Signoria of [GetCountry('FLO').GetName] is the name of the council of nine that governs the city, its members taken from the different guilds. Every two months, a lottery is held to reelect the council members. This constant shuffling ensures that the interests of the Republic prevail over personal ones. The fact all its members come from the guilds, though, makes it so that the same families are always the ones in charge.

name: Tysiatskii Office
description: The Tysiatskii are military leaders selected from the Boyars. While in other states their responsibilities lie mostly in commanding our soldiers, our Tysiatskii Office serves additional functions as the representative of the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')], as acting judges in the commercial court, and as supervisors of our fortifications.

name: The Ryad
description: $the_ryad_privilege$ is the given name to the contract signed between the Boyars and the state. It protects the interests and powers of the Boyars while also defining the responsibilities and rights of the Prince.

name: Kaigama
description: The Kaigama is the governor of our Southern territories and the chief of the army. With power, vigor, and tremendous influence, [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] who hold this title have at times even played the role of king-makers, as they may decide who shall rule.

name: Yerima
description: The Yerima is the governor of our Northern territories and in charge of levying able-bodied fighters to form the lower castes of our armed forces. While not enjoying as much influence as the Kaigama, we may yet come to rely on what sway the Yerima does have when recruiting soldiers, since we continue to struggle against exterior and interior foes alike.

name: Cima Fiefs
description: As a reward for their victories on the battlefield, we grant frontier territories to our military commanders. This helps to solidify their loyalty to us, and improves the influence our capital has over our distant borderlands.

name: Office of the Farima-Soura
description: Charged with guarding the northern border, the Farima-Soura monitors traffic across the Saharan border, and oversees the safety and swift passage of all mercantile traffic in and out of our borders.

name: Office of the Sankar-Zouma
description: The Sankar-Zouma is a prestigious office granted to the [GetCountry('MAL').GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] by the highest authority in the land. Its role, much like the Farima-Soura, revolves around exercising authority along all trade routes across the southern border.

name: Golden Liberty
description: The Golden Liberty, also known as #italic Złota Wolność#!, represents the significant influence and privileges currently held by our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], including the right to elect the ruler and shape national policy. It entailed that all [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], regardless of rank, economic status, or ethnic background, were considered equal in power to their peers.

name: Statutes of Nieszawa
description: A series of laws which grant significant concessions to the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] by requiring their approval for new laws, mobilization of armed forces, and new taxes. These statutes also diminished the power of the richest families, and strengthened the position of the broader nobility.

name: Pacta Conventa
description: Originally conceived as a contractual agreement between the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] and the government, these statutes spell out the responsibilities of central authority and outline various undertakings in areas like foreign policy, taxes, military matters, and more.

name: Noble Armies
description: Permitting the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] to maintain personal armies is an excellent way to ensure they contribute when we form larger state armies, while also incurring more influence.

name: Chancellor Nobles
description: Deriving from the lesser branches of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], these administrators are responsible for drafting governmental decisions into legal documents, forming the basis of our administration.

name: Great Offices of the Crown of [GetCountry('FRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: The most important governmental offices within our central administration are reserved for the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] within our realm.

name: Residence in Versailles
description: The [GetCountry('FRA').GetGovernment.GetAdjective] family has extended an offer of residence for members of the prominent [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] dynasties to live in the palace of Versailles.

name: Permanent Residence in Versailles
description: Expansions have been made to Versailles allowing for members of the [GetCountry('FRA').GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] to take up permanent residence at the palace alongside the [GetCountry('FRA').GetGovernment.GetAdjective] family. While those not of the [GetCountry('FRA').GetGovernment.GetAdjective] family enjoy the luxuries of the palace, it has come at the cost of greatly diminished political influence, in order to maintain the favor of the [GetCountry('FRA').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle]. This abandonment of their personal estates has also left less room for political intrigue and plotting, making them beholden to the rule of Versailles.

name: Right to Inherit
description: The [ShowCultureGroupName('german_group')] [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] maintains the long-standing tradition of dividing the lands and titles of the father between all of the sons, ensuring the peace between brothers and avoiding unnecessary wars.

name: Inaugural Diplomas
description: In a bid to forge strong ties with the elite members of our society, we have granted them a series of benefits under the agreement of the $inaugural_diplomas$. Among the concessions are reduced levy obligations to the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] and the right to reduced taxation.

name: District Taxation
description: Maintaining the pathways between the many districts of [ShowLocationName('prague')] is a contentious topic among the elites. Granting them the right to tax the paving of new roads will inevitably build more connections between our districts.

name: Joint Assembly Decrees
description: A series of rights granted to the elite members of our country so as to promote integration and uniformity between them and their many peers across the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Kormlenije
description: The Kormlenije System is a mechanism to address the financial and material needs of the $RUS_ADJ$ [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], establishing a financial dependency among the elites. This dependency, in turn, plays a crucial role in securing their unwavering loyalty.

name: Ordinance of Laborers
description: To the great dismay of the lowborn, this ordinance has been passed to prevent the spiraling salary costs of the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')], effectively fixing wages to pre-plague levels. Employers are also prevented from hiring excess workers, and it is mandatory that all those under the age of sixty must work.

name: Autonomous Local Commanders
description: The local commanders that man the posts of our Order have long demanded increased autonomy, in the name of efficient self-governance and allegiance to our cause.

name: Baština Grants
description: The system of land grants for our elites is inspired by the Byzantine system of #italic Pronoias#!. It grants them a grand array of privileges and obligations on behalf of their domains when it comes to administering the lands leased to them by the government.

name: Župa Districts
description: The compartmentalization and division of our society is detailed in the various legal frameworks that surround our administrative branch. The most important aspect of our society and bureaucracy is the division of our provinces into Župa districts, aimed at improving how local affairs are handled.

name: Krajiška Vlastela
description: Our borderlands must be safely guarded at all times. To that end, the system of #italic krajine#! splits our frontiers into well-administered districts under the command of local lords, known as #italic Krajiška Vlastela#!, who are in charge of maintaining and protecting the people of their provinces.

name: Golden Bull of 1222
description: A foundational document that enshrines the rights and privileges of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. By virtue of this treaty, they are granted exemption from direct taxation, ensuring that they suffer no financial burdens from the state's demands. Moreover, this privilege limits their obligations to provide troops, safeguarding their liberties while enhancing their influence in the kingdom.

name: Monetary Fiefs
description: Rather than granting permanent hereditary fiefs to [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], the crown retains direct ownership of most lands and appoints temporary administrators to manage them. These officials enjoy the revenues and authority of their territories only while holding office; upon their death or dismissal, control reverts to the crown. This prevents powerful hereditary aristocracies from forming and bolsters administrative loyalty.

name: Scholar Officials
description:
Our elite class is composed of wise government officials and politicians who gained their enviable positions by proving their knowledge in the national examinations.
The families of these officials may maintain their privileged status as long as they produce at least one official every three generations.

name: Ghazi Lords
description: Warriors for the faith, these devoted fighters campaign across distant frontiers in pursuit of plunder, honor, and divine purpose. Comprised of zealous volunteers and tribal raiders, they guard our borders through relentless raids and conquests, spreading both influence and fear in equal measure.

name: Share of the Spoils
description: Victory always tastes sweeter when our great clan hoards the spoils. However, by sharing them, we will breed goodwill with other powerful clans, which can be used to our advantage later.

name: Tribal Host
description: Breeding the strongest horses shall be the cornerstone of our powerful host. By entrusting the process to our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], we will ensure that we will never run out of mounts for our legendary warriors.

name: Tribal Autonomy
description: Our forefathers, and their fathers before them, venerated living life freely outside the walls of settlements. We would do well to follow their example, distancing ourselves from the outside influences seeking to seduce our people away from their true path...

name: Powerful [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('italian_group')] Families
description: The anarchy and disobedience in the city of [ShowLocationName('rome')] and the other [ShowCultureGroupName('italian_group')] estates greatly increased after the [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] moved the court to [ShowLocationName('avignon')]. Now those territories are under the control of powerful Italian families such as the Colonna and [ShowDynastyName('orsini_dynasty')], who are almost completely independent of the [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle].

name: Empower [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('orthodox')] $nobles_estate$
description: This privilege grants the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] many of the privileges and assurances that have been granted exclusively to the rest of our elites.

name: [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('scottish_group')] Clans
description: The people of [GetCountry('SCO').GetName] have been traditionally organized in multiple clans, each one united in both terms of kinship and geographical location, and owing allegiance to their own clan chief. Clan gatherings and interrelation among them is what drives [GetCountry('SCO').GetAdjective] politics.

name: Autonomous $scottish_clans$
description: $scottish_clans_desc$

name: Statutes of Iona
description: Through these Statutes, the clans of the rural highlands are expected to send their heirs to be educated in the schools of the lowlands. While this will bring about a more educated generation of highland [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], it risks eroding centuries of cultural heritage.

name: Coign and Livery
description: This system, also known as #italic bonnacht#!, requires that our lesser chieftains must billet our loyal soldiers in their own holdings at their own expense.

name: Libro d'Oro
description: The Great Council of [GetCountry('VEN').GetName] has many rules that determine who is worthy of being a member. One is the #italic Libro d'Oro#!, which contains a list of families that meet these requisites and can claim to belong to the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] of [GetCountry('VEN').GetNameWithNoTooltip]. Only through a great quantity of gold and influence can changes be made to it.

name: Avogadoria de Comùn
description:
The state is in the hands of the noble and wealthy families who occupy key positions in the [GetCountry('VEN').GetAdjective] government. To defend the interests of the state and, by extension, of these families, the Council created the #italic Avogadoria de Comùn#! - the #italic public prosecutors#! - who supervise accounts of high positions, investigate allegations of corruption and prosecute violations of law.
Even the Doges themselves are not spared by their watchful eyes...

name: Zonta
description: The governing councils of the [GetCountry('VEN').GetFlavorRank] of [GetCountry('VEN').GetName] choose their members from among the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. These elites come together in so-called #italic Zontas#! and have privileges and duties to safeguard the constitution against the accumulation of power by a single ruler.

name: Rajput Society
description:
The Rajputs are an ancient caste of honorable warriors and proud nobles. While the rugged land of [ShowAreaName('rajputana_area')] is the heart of their power, Rajput [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] can be found throughout northern $india$, and many great Rajas claim Rajput descent.

#italic Modifier scales with the percentage amount of [ShowCultureName('mewari')], [ShowCultureName('harauti')], [ShowCultureName('dhundhari')], [ShowCultureName('shekhawati')], and [ShowCultureName('mewati')] present in our country + extra 100%.#!

name: Zamindar Tax Privilege
description: $mug_zamindar_system_desc$ In times of war, it is the right of the Zamindar to collect taxes to support our war efforts. Granting this privilege will greatly increase our income — but also the power of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]...

name: Consolidated Corruption of the Elites
description: The entrenched members of the upper classes $corruption_desc$

name: Privilege of Koszyce
description: The elite members of our society have been bestowed with a wide range of rights, in exchange for allowing a foreign heir rule the state. Furthermore, they will no longer be burdened with taxes without their consent.

name: Nihil Novi
description: The elite members of our society have secured the right to not have any laws made without their consent. Not only that, this privilege also forbids freedom of movement of the serfs and limits rights of the townsfolk.

name: Noble Navy
description: Our navy is maintained and controlled by the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. Thanks to their financial contributions, we will be able to raise a mighty fleet, although in exchange for permitting the $nobles_estate$ to have more influences over naval affairs.

name: Charter of the Nobility
description: Following the Pugachev uprising, a charter was issued that strengthens the privileges of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] and emphasizes their role in maintaining order.

name: Reduced Responsibilities for the Elites
description: In an effort to secure the favor and allegiance of our society's upper echelons, we have decided to grant them this this privilege, alleviating them of many of their responsibilities.

name: Reduced Taxation for the Elites
description: The upper echelons of our society hold significant influence and power and, as such, their whims and opinions carry great weight. If we do not want them to tip the balance of power towards their estate, we must allow them certain tax concessions.

name: Heritable [ShowLawNameWithNoTooltip('iqta_law')]
description: The post of [ShowLawName('iqta_law')] holder is not usually heritable. Transforming it into a hereditary one would be unprecedented, and would increase the loyalty of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')].

name: Manifesto of Freedom
description:
Following a period of political turmoil, the elite members of our society are granted extensive civil liberties to ensure their continued loyalty.

The manifesto remains in effect for the entirety of the current rule, and may prove challenging to revoke.

name: [GetCountry('BAV').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Land Division
description: We have divided our dynastic lands justly and in accordance to the law. This will lead to further fragmentation of our lands and a heavily decentralized administration. To emerge as a powerful contender among the princes of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName], we will have to assert our control and central authority once more.

name: Fuero Viejo de Castilla
description: We have compiled the scattered laws and customs of our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. This codification of their privileges shall serve as the cornerstone of their elevated status in our realm.

name: Justicia de Aragón
description: Justicia de Aragón is a powerful legal and judicial office in the [GetCountry('ARA').GetLongName], established to uphold regional laws, mediate disputes, and protect the rights of subjects against royal overreach.

name: Formalized Oath of Loyalty
description: The monarchy is bound by a formalized agreement that requires the rights and freedoms of the estates to be recognized and upheld before an oath of loyalty can be sworn.

name: Ayan Notables
description: No one knows the complex power dynamics of far-flung provinces better than the elites who already reside there. Given status as Ayans, they are trusted to govern with only limited oversight from the state.

name: Regimiento
description: The Regimiento is a system implemented to govern the town and cities of [GetCountry('CAS').GetName] through certain appointed councilmen, who come from the ranks of the richest and most powerful families.

name: Integrated [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('ruthenian')] Laws
description: By integrating the laws of our [ShowCultureName('ruthenian')] people, we can more effectively work towards establishing a standard code for the realm.

name: Protection of [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('orthodox')] $nobles_estate$
description: The numerous [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] who follow the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] faith deserve equal status to those that do not. By guaranteeing them these rights, they will be more likely to support us going forward.

name: Refined Furūsiyya
description: Through centuries of martial tradition, we have refined Furūsiyya, the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] code of chivalry and military practice, blending horsemanship, archery, and warfare tactics with intellectual and ethical training.

name: Banned Weapons for [GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('peasants_estate')]
description: Our realm is home to a diverse population, which occasionally leads to conflict. If we permit our people to remain armed, these minor squabbles could explode into all-out war. It is for that reason our [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] may no longer carry any weapons on their persons.

name: Crusader Elite
description: While the fall of the Latin empire may have splintered the crusader $nobles_estate$, they still maintain a powerful force throughout [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')] that cannot be ignored.

name: Noble Patronage of the Arts
description: Several prominent families within the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] have taken to sponsoring poets, painters, and scholars in their courts and villas. While some may see this as vanity, such patronage often gives rise to bold new schools of thought and expression, typically in exchange for more influence with the court.

name: Statutes of Piotrkow
description: These statutes are a symbol of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]'s efforts to consolidate their privileges, and the grip that serfdom and aristocracy have on power. Through the weakening of the lower social classes and towns, the $nobles_estate$ seek to assert their influence.

name: Free Mobility for the Common People
description:
People are the most valuable asset of any state. Famines and discord would be the norm without them. Yet, the elites see them only as property — as possessions to hoard upon their ill-gotten lands!
By granting free mobility to the masses, their fate will be own hands once again, allowing them to leave the lands of their former masters and move to new, more fruitful fields.

name: Represented in Parliament
description: Granting our lower populace a seat in our main assembly will give a voice to the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')], of our country and ensure greater rights for them.

name: Means of Production
description: The upper classes are vultures, devouring the fruits of hard peasant labor and contributing nothing in return. By seizing the means of production, we will place the future of our nation and its people in our own hands!

name: Fewer Levies
description:
The [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] are the lifeblood of our state. They nourish our population, craft the materials for our buildings, and produce the goods our [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] trade in.
Although war is a time of great hardship for our state, we must make the effort to keep our [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] away from the conflict if we want to avoid famine and economic collapse after the war.

name: Yeomanry
description: Freeholdeers with small land possessions receive elevated rights in return for taking on some responsibilities of petty nobles, including having to fulfill higher expectations regarding the defense of the realm.

name: Common Militias
description: The common people are allowed to keep their weapons, which they then must use when called for levy service.

name: Protected Faith of the Common People
description: The common people have gained Religious Protections and are therefore exempt from any conversion attempts from the state.

name: Hunting Permits
description: Allows the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] to hunt and skin game within the legal and physical boundaries of their lord's or township's domain.

name: No Labor on Sunday
description: It would be wise to follow the teachings of the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] Church and decree our serfs and peasants may have respite from their work on Sundays, as a sign of piety and compassion.

name: Communal Lands
description: Despite the inherently disadvantaged position of the common people, we must nevertheless dictate that all members of the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] have the right to establish common flocks of animals and to raise crops in shared fields.

name: Partial Yield
description: The lands of the wealthy are often tilled by [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')], slaves, or serfs. Thus, the least we can do is award the common people with access to a portion of that land's yield every year.

name: Access to Royal & Ecclesiastical Courts
description: The legal representation of the less fortunate is a vital aspect of a just and balanced society. Public and religious courts should therefore handle legal disputes between [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] and the elites as fairly as possible.

name: Commoners in the Administration
description: By involving the most skilled amongst the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] in our government, we can improve and expand the reach of our administration into the most remote areas of our territory.

name: Autonomous Villages
description: In the rural settlements of our state, there is a saying: 'The laws of the sovereign end at the village's gate.' The people in our settlements organize themselves independently from the central authority of this country.

name: Consolidated Corruption of the Common People
description: The people no longer respect our authority. Indeed, in many cases, they have threatened to take up arms should they be forced to pay their taxes...

name: Exempt from Poll Tax
description: Following Wat Tyler's uprising, the punitive poll tax is abolished and insurances are given that it will not be reintroduced.

name: Sindicat Remença
description: The Sindicat Remença is a peasants' guild or primitive trade union. This was first introduced in Catalonia in 1448.

name: Creaghts
description: Many of the lower classes belong to pastoral #italic creaghts#!, bands of nomadic herders. They migrate seasonally to fresh grazing lands, and are named for the temporary dwellings they build as they move from place to place. As they are not tied to specific land, they exist outside any feudal structure.

name: Masaniello's Fight
description: The demands of Masaniello the fisherman are represented in this privilege that protects the common folk from tyrannical taxes, and cushions them in case of economic disaster.

name: Both Days Sabbath
description: Contrary to the mainstream doctrine, the ancient tradition of our people has been observing both the seventh-day Sabbath on Saturdays and the Lord's Day on Sundays. This privilege codifies those customs into law and protects the peasantry from persecution.

name: Ius Teutonicum
description: Since the times of the eastern marches of the Carolingian Empire, [ShowCultureGroupName('german_group')] peoples have been expanding and settling further east. Known as #italic Ostsiedlung#!, this influx of [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('german_group')] settlers is often encouraged by local rulers to fill sparsely populated areas. These settlers are subject to a special type of law, the #italic $ius_teutonicum$#!, offering them special privileges like tax exemptions and the right to establish self-governing towns.

name: Invite [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('german_group')] Settlers
description: By welcoming migrants into our nation, we will build a strong country that benefits from population growth and shifting regional dynamics.

name: Haudenosaunee Labor Division
description: Our people have clearly defined roles within their communities. Tasks are distributed and assigned for the collective benefit of the group, with those sharing the same tasks working together. Men and women fulfill complementary roles through their respective assignments, creating a holistic division of labor.

name: Mit'a System
description: With the implementation of the #italic mit'a#! system, all males from the ages of fifteen to fifty are required to provide one year of free labor to the government. The labor is regulated so that it does not conflict with each person's ability to provide for their family.

name: Gradozidanije and Gradobljudenije
description: Our domain is home to many fortifications and formidable strongholds. The maintenance expenses and garrisoning of these emplacements have been entrusted to the local population and townspeople.

name: [ShowGoodsNameWithNoTooltip('salt')] Tax Exemption
description: The scarcity and high price of [ShowGoodsName('salt')] has resulted in economic hardships for the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')]. They are hereby exempt from any tax on [ShowGoodsNameWithNoTooltip('salt')] in order to quickly alleviate economic hardships and reduce social unrest.

name: Tractatus de Iuribus Incorporalibus
description: The regulated relations between landowners and [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] will secure some legal protection for our lowest estate, although this will make expanding our farming economy more difficult.

name: Ayuntamientos
description: The right to establish town councils with clear legislative and executive jurisdictions is a clear and fundamental right of the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] within our domain.

name: Caballeros Villanos
description: The borderlands of [ShowAreaName('castile_area')] and [ShowAreaName('leon_area')] have, over the last few centuries, produced a unique order of knightly shepherds. They are accustomed to spending winters guarding their flocks in border strongholds and spending their summers raiding or waging war against their [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] foes.

name: Kholop Protection Rights
description: Instead of allowing the lower strata from being exploited by the rich, we shall grant and guarantee basic human rights to the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')].

name: Land-Owning Peasants
description: [GetCountry('SWE').GetAdjective] peasants hold a uniquely strong position compared to their peers in much of feudal [ShowContinentName('europe')]. They own their land outright, pay taxes directly to the crown, and often have a voice in local assemblies, giving them a degree of autonomy and legal protection. These farmers were not serfs; many are armed and serve in levies. Their rights are rooted in ancient customary law, and their relative independence is a foundational element of Swedish rural society.

name: Compromise with the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] people
description: While the ruling Crusader elite may still wield great influence, some of the remaining [ShowCultureName('greek_culture')] families still wield considerable power of their own. Finding a compromise between the ruling and formerly powerful elite would be the best way to build a stable rule in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')].

name: Tribal Land Rights
description: Expanding and respecting the land rights of the many tribal communities in our realm is an excellent way to ensure their continued cooperation.

name: Allow Gatherings
description: Regular gatherings of our tribal communities are an excellent forum in which to discuss politics, exchange information, and negotiate the flow of business to many settlements across our realm. Therefore, we shall allow them.

name: Pasture Access
description: By granting pasture access to our tribal communities, we can utilize their advanced knowledge about growing crops and raising [ShowGoodsName('livestock')].

name: Allow Tribal Levies
description: Our tribal warriors are famed for their warfare experience. To employ these hard men within our armies will only serve to empower our forces and further secure our domain.

name: Expanded Registry
description: Despite our local tribal communities living a life largely detached from that of our mainstream society, we should nevertheless ensure that they are properly accounted for in our registry.

name: Protected Tribal Faith
description: Those who dwell in the wildest stretches of our land sometimes subscribe to different beliefs. As they are loyal subjects under our banner, we would do well to respect their religious differences.

name: Respected Tribal Traditions
description: The fascinating traditions followed by members of the tribal communities in our society should be respected, and supported by the state.

name: Creach
description: The cultivation and husbandry of [ShowGoodsName('livestock')] we have procured through warfare and raiding is an excellent way to safeguard the prosperity of our tribal people.

name: Fosterage
description: By fostering the next generation of tribal members in neighboring families, their unique knowledge will be passed down, and bonds of kinship and alliance between communities will be strengthened.

name: Manrent
description: By engaging in contractual conscription work, many members of our tribal communities enter into the service of our most influential families.

name: United [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('scottish_group')] Heritage
description: For generations, the clans of the rural northern highlands have retained their [ShowLanguageName('gaelic_language')] identity, while the clans of the lowlands have largely developed their own [ShowCultureGroupName('scottish_group')] culture. Despite differing practices, the clans of the highlands and lowlands will nevertheless set aside their differences to fight foreign adversaries that threaten [GetCountry('SCO').GetName].

name: Autonomous $tribes_scotland_gaelic_heritage$
description: $tribes_scotland_gaelic_heritage_desc$

name: Jaysh Armies
description: Organized by the local administration to perform garrison and auxiliary duties, these fighters were hired to suppress local revolts and ensure the constant flow of reinforcements into our army, while also suppressing rebellions in their home territories.

name: Tribal Cabinet
description: Our tribal communities are an important cornerstone of our state. It is only right that we allow those willing to contribute to our administration to serve in high positions.

name: Tribal Strongholds
description: The many settled tribes across the Maghreb exert great influence over the locals. To appease them and recognize their authority will help us exert control over our domain with greater ease.

name: Tribal Favor
description: The [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('jurchen_culture')] elites are given primacy in state affairs, and are grateful for our refusal to adopt foreign customs.
